description:
Chul-soo is late for work one morning, only to find someone stuck in the elevator. Thus begins the worst possible day of his life as everything goes wrong all at once. On the flipside is a street vendor that looks very much like Chul-soo, selling pirated DVDs. Though his basement apartment is shady like his business, he soon meets the bright new girl Bora. Adapted from the award-winning collection of short-stories, 'Elevator' unrolls hand-drawn sketches of everyday absurdity and effervescent hope
